patch_description: Fundamentally different paradigm: instead of 3-fold symmetry seeds + gradient ascent, this uses a population-based Differential Evolution (DE) search over all 26 coordinates with a smooth soft-min objective, seeded heavily with boundary-dominant configurations (research suggests optimal Heilbronn configs put most points on the convex hull). DE's crossover/mutation recombination explores the landscape globally without symmetry traps; a final exact hard-min coordinate polish converts the smooth optimum into a true min-area maximum. Fully deterministic (fixed RNG), vectorized fitness evaluation, ~30-60s budget.
